name: Hidden Signs of Love
source:
Embark on a journey of love and chilling discovery in "Hidden Signs of Love," a captivating dating sim visual novel. The story unfolds as you, the player, and the charming love interest, Kai, have a serendipitous encounter at your favorite café. The air is filled with anticipation as your lives become intertwined in unexpected ways. As you navigate the intricacies of romance, the game presents a tapestry of emotions, choices, and hidden signs that shape the destiny of your relationship with Kai. Engage in delightful conversations, go on exciting dates, and uncover the unique qualities that make your connection special. Are you ready to unravel the mysteries of love and let "destiny" guide your heart? Play now and discover the hidden signs that will lead you to a love story like no other.

[From [url=https://alicewtw.itch.io/hidden-signs-of-love-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《隐藏的爱的迹象》中踏上一段爱情之旅和令人毛骨悚然的发现之旅，这是一部引人入胜的约会模拟视觉小说。当你，玩家，和迷人的爱人凯，在你最喜欢的咖啡馆偶然相遇时，故事就展开了。当你们的生活以意想不到的方式交织在一起时，空气中充满了期待。当你探索错综复杂的爱情故事时，游戏呈现出一系列情感、选择和隐藏的迹象，这些都决定了你与凯关系的命运。进行愉快的对话，进行激动人心的约会，并发现使你们的关系变得特别的独特品质。你准备好揭开爱情的谜团，让“命运”引导你的心了吗？现在就玩，发现隐藏的标志，将引导你进入一个与众不同的爱情故事。

[来自[url=https://alicewtw.itch.io/hidden-signs-of-love-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
